messages:
marta: Heads up — planning to promote payment-service chart to eu-west during the 02:00-04:00 UTC change window. Values include a rate-limiter toggle and DB pool bump. Tagging @sanjay @emily for validation.
sanjay: Quick Q — the chart in the image registry is v1.5.0 but our last known-good in eu-west is v1.4.2. There was an upstream sidecar bump in v1.5.0 that we haven't smoke-tested.
emily: I saw the sidecar change. It drops an env var (`FE_JWT_TTL`) in the chart. The app tolerates missing var but it's used by a small batch job. Need to confirm no cron jobs break.
deploy-bot: Promotion request received: chart payment-service v1.5.0 -> eu-west (canary=10%, window=30m). Preflight checks: values-schema OK, image pullable, no broken CRDs. CI: passed.
Tom: Can we instead pin to v1.4.2 and do a quick patch for the rate-limiter? Pin avoids the unvalidated sidecar change.
emily: Pin works but v1.4.2 doesn't include the new rate-limiter boolean. We can supply the feature via Helm values override though.
marta: Proposal: do a staged approach — manual canary at 5% for 30m on v1.5.0 but with values that keep the sidecar in legacy mode (feature flags off). If canary stable -> promote. If we see errors, rollback to pinned v1.4.2.
sanjay: I prefer pin-first then hotpatch promotion for the rate-limiter. Reason: payments is heat-sensitive and we can't afford cron failures during window. But manual canary + conservative values is acceptable if oncall is ready.
Tom: I'll be oncall during the window. Agree to manual canary at 5% for 30m, monitor error-rate and latency. Rollback criteria: error-rate increase >1% or 95th latency +200ms.
emily: Values snippet I'm proposing for the canary (explicitly overriding the sidecar flag):
```yaml
sidecar:
  compat_mode: true
payment:
  rate_limiter: true
  max_conn: 80
```
marta: Also adding release notes: "Enable optional rate-limiter behind feature flag; no expected user-facing changes. Sidecar compat_mode enabled for eu-west canary."
sre-bot: Pre-canary checklist: metrics dashboard link: https://dashboard.internal/redwood/payments-eu-west, alert runbook: https://oncall.internal/runbooks/payments. Pager oncall: @tom.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment started: payment-service v1.5.0 -> eu-west (5%) at 3180001400. Tracking canary metrics for 30m.
Tom: Canary running. Initial traffic looks good. No error spikes in the first 10m.
emily: Spot-checked cron logs on one replica — job runs and exits 0.
marta: OK, if no regressions at 30m we promote to 20% then 100% over 1h. On any regression we pin to v1.4.2 and run hotfix later.
sanjay: If we pin, we'll need an off-hours PR to backport the rate-limiter default so we can roll forward without sidecar risk.
deploy-bot: Canary passed at 3180001600 (30m). Proceeding to 20% -> scheduled increment in 10m.
Tom: Monitoring during the 20% step. No anomalies so far.
sre-bot: FYI automated alert threshold set: error-rate >1% or 95th latency +200ms triggers autoscale and rollback hold.
emily: Promoted to 100% at 3180002000. Post-promote smoke checks OK.
marta: Thanks team. I'll draft the release notes and include the pin plan in case we need it: chart v1.4.2 @sha256:deadbeef as emergency pin.
sanjay: noted. I'll open the backport PR for the rate-limiter defaults.
deploy-bot: Promotion complete: payment-service v1.5.0 -> eu-west (100%) at 3180002300. No rollback triggered. :tada:
marta: Closing loop — creating release note PR and linking this thread. Great work everyone.
